title: 病假全壘打
subject: an office worker who leaves at four claiming a dizzy spell 'to see a doctor', catches a ninth-inning home-run ball in his fried-chicken bag in the Taipei Dome outfield on live TV, and is told by his baseball-mad manager to bring the ball in the next morning
caption: Mandarin pop-punk in the early-2000s sing-along style. Two palm-muted distorted electric guitars chugging eighth-note power chords and opening up on the chorus; a punchy picked electric bass; fast drums with a driving backbeat, double-time fills and crash cymbals; a short bright guitar lead line between sections. Tight bright band mix, loud and dry, guitars hard-panned wide. Male tenor, slightly nasal and youthful, half-shouted verses, shouted gang vocals on the chorus. 172 BPM, D major. Busted, giddy and gleeful. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no metalcore screaming, no hardcore punk blast beats, no ballad slowdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitars and snare roll]

[Verse 1]
下午四點 我跟經理說
頭好暈 我想先去看醫生
六點半 戴著口罩 溜進大巨蛋
外野第三排 一手雞排 一手啤酒

[Pre-Chorus]
九局下半 兩人出局
那顆球 朝我這邊 越變越大

[Chorus - Gang Vocals]
病假全壘打 我用雞排袋接到
全場都站起來 大螢幕上全是我
口罩掉到下巴 我笑到停不下來
病假全壘打 電視重播第三遍

[Instrumental Break - short bright guitar lead]

[Verse 2]
回家的捷運上 手機一直震
我媽打來問 你不是說要加班
大學室友問 雞排到底吃完沒
最後一個 是經理 他問 頭還暈嗎

[Pre-Chorus]
他說 明天早上 把球帶來
病假的事 他可以當沒看到

[Chorus - Gang Vocals]
病假全壘打 球擺在經理桌上
他擦了又擦 還拍照傳給他老婆
下禮拜主場 換他說頭好暈
病假全壘打 這次我留下來加班

[Instrumental Break - short bright guitar lead]

[Chorus - Gang Vocals]
病假全壘打 我用雞排袋接到
全場都站起來 大螢幕上全是我
口罩掉到下巴 我笑到停不下來
病假全壘打 電視重播第一百遍

[Outro - full band, final crash]
頭好暈
我到現在 還在發燒
